text_block_list.name: Labyrinth Queen
text_block_list.text: Ahem, well then, since what we've got right here is a bunch of people who rarely don't get to see each other, let's have a party!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えーそれじゃ、
普段はめったに揃わない顔が集まってることだし、
打ち上げでもやろっか！

text_block_list.name: 4 people
text_block_list.text: There's no way I'd join."  "No chance." "No way in hell." "I'll pass.
text_block_list.orig_text:
「やらないわよ。」「やりませんね。」
「やらんだろうな。」「やるわけがない。」

text_block_list.name: Guiding Elder
text_block_list.orig_text:
晶、
お前は変わらないな。

text_block_list.name: Kaiser Insight
text_block_list.text: However, you're right... A party to clean up all those troublesome opponents in front of me sounds like a wonderful idea, doesn't it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
そうねぇ……
面倒な相手をまとめてお掃除する打ち上げなら、
いいかもしれないわね？

text_block_list.name: Regina Geas
text_block_list.text: I see, using that excuse you're trying to get rid of all loose ends... including us! Haha, just the kind of party I love☆
text_block_list.orig_text:
なるほど、
合縁奇縁、
一切合切を斬り捨てようと。
ハハッ、
ワタシ好みの打ち上げになりそうだ☆

text_block_list.name: Leap King
text_block_list.text: Ohh. That sounds better than any party I've ever been to. I don't mind, so go ahead?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほう。
どんな酒宴よりも楽しそうではありませんか。
私は構いませんよ？

text_block_list.name: Metamorph Regnant
text_block_list.text: This is why I don't like people whose communication skills are just replaced with meaningless violence. If you're really up for this, then be my guest.
text_block_list.orig_text:
コミュニケーションツールが暴力で埋まった輩はこれだから嫌なんです。
やるならご勝手に。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ねぇ晶、
止めなくていいわけ？

text_block_list.name: Labyrinth Queen
text_block_list.text: Hm? Well, they can do whatever they want...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？　
まぁ好きにさせとけばいいよ。

text_block_list.name: Labyrinth Queen
text_block_list.text: --After all, that's how we've always been.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──アタシたちは昔から、
ずっとそうだったからさ。
